# rlsbl discover

List the GitHub repositories carrying the rlsbl topic, most recently updated first, through the authenticated gh command line. With --mine, only the repositories the authenticated account owns. GitHub's search returns at most 1000 repositories, and a topic carried by more is refused rather than listed in part.

**Effect:** read_only

## Flags

| Name | Short | Type | Presence | Env | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--mine`, `--no-mine` |  | bool | default: `false` |  | List only the repositories the authenticated GitHub account owns |
